purpose: End-to-end AI workflow for adding or updating DSA problems.

steps.action: Check whether the problem already exists in Notion.
Open 1-2 good existing Notion problem pages for reference.
Read all relevant GitHub files for the problem.
Identify additional brute/better/optimal approaches when useful.
Create or update the GitHub README and canonical solution consistently.
Create or update the Notion page using notion.json.
Use a strong dry-run example and real Notion tables.

priority_rules: Current JSON specs override older markdown examples if there is a conflict.
Do not copy known formatting mistakes from old pages.
